description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged attacks (0.60 each), grants [Linked Materia Mode III (Fire, Lightning)], [Synchro Mode] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user, grants Rookie Ringer +1/2 to the user if 0/1+ of Reno or Rude are alive, grants [Buff Prismatic 10% (15s)]/[Buff Prismatic 20% (15s)]/[Buff Prismatic 30% (15s)] to all allies if 0-1/2/3+ FF7 allies are alive

description.name: Upgrenade
description.text: One single ranged attack (0.80/5.34) capped at 9999/99999 if the user has Rookie Ringer level 0/1+, grants [Fire/Lightning Ability +30% Boost 2]/[Weakness +30% Boost 2] to the user/all allies if the user has Rookie Ringer level 0/1+, causes Rookie Ringer -1 to the user

description.name: Linked Materia Mode III (Fire, Lightning)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] after using an Fire/Lightning ability

description.name: Buff Prismatic 10% (15s)
description.text: Grants [Buff Fire 10% (15s)], [Buff Ice 10% (15s)], [Buff Lightning 10% (15s)], [Buff Earth 10% (15s)], [Buff Wind 10% (15s)], [Buff Water 10% (15s)], [Buff Holy 10% (15s)], [Buff Dark 10% (15s)] and [Buff Poison 10% (15s)]

description.name: Buff Prismatic 30% (15s)
